"""
[P₁  0
         0   P₃][    L        0
                 P₃ᵀCP₂ᵀU⁻¹  -L̃][U  L⁻¹P₁ᵀB
                                 0     Ũ   ][P₂   0
                                             0   I_2]
        where
        P_i: ℝ^(2×2)
        B: ℝ^(2×2)
        C: ℝ^(2×2)
        L: ℝ^(2×2)
        L̃: ℝ^(2×2)
        U: ℝ^(2×2)
        Ũ: ℝ^(2×2)
"""
import numpy as np
import scipy
import scipy.linalg
from scipy import sparse
from scipy.integrate import quad, solve_ivp
from scipy.optimize import minimize


class heartlib:
    def __init__(self, P, B, C, L, L̃, U, Ũ):
        P = np.asarray(P, dtype=np.float64)
        B = np.asarray(B, dtype=np.float64)
        C = np.asarray(C, dtype=np.float64)
        L = np.asarray(L, dtype=np.float64)
        L̃ = np.asarray(L̃, dtype=np.float64)
        U = np.asarray(U, dtype=np.float64)
        Ũ = np.asarray(Ũ, dtype=np.float64)
        dim_0 = P.shape[0]
        assert P.shape == (dim_0, 2, 2)
        assert B.shape == (2, 2)
        assert C.shape == (2, 2)
        assert L.shape == (2, 2)
        assert L̃.shape == (2, 2)
        assert U.shape == (2, 2)
        assert Ũ.shape == (2, 2)
        ret_0 = np.block([[P[1-1], np.zeros((2, 2))], [np.zeros((2, 2)), P[3-1]]])
        ret_1 = np.block([[L, np.zeros((2, 2))], [P[3-1].T @ C @ P[2-1].T @ np.linalg.inv(U), -L̃]])
        ret_2 = np.block([[U, np.linalg.solve(L, P[1-1].T) @ B], [np.zeros((2, 2)), Ũ]])
        ret_3 = np.block([[P[2-1], np.zeros((2, 2))], [np.zeros((2, 2)), np.identity(2)]])
        self.ret = ret_0 @ ret_1 @ ret_2 @ ret_3
